description: A fast, minimalist, AI-native email client for Windows
notes: Skim's built-in updater stays quiet on Scoop installs - run 'scoop update skim' instead.
Mail, settings, and credentials live outside the app folder, so they survive an update or uninstall.
post_install: # Unpacking the NSIS installer with 7-Zip yields the app plus installer-only
# leftovers: 7-Zip's scratch folder and the stock uninstaller, which would
# try to remove an install that was never registered. Scoop owns removal here.
# Marker read by the app: Scoop owns this install, so don't self-update behind its back.

script: # Mirrors NSIS_HOOK_POSTUNINSTALL — the app registers these at runtime.
